Ivy (PM): Quick last-mile check for GA tomorrow: SLA metric finalization, customer-facing rollback steps, monitoring suppressions, pricing SKUs, and support templates. Can we confirm owners?
Marcus (Eng): Eng owns rollback bullets and code snippets. I'll paste 3-line curl + SDK in 20m.
Lena (SRE): I'll own suppression plan and the smoke-run checklist. Proposing 10m info, 10-45m warn, >45m page.
Owen (Finance): I'll lock SKUs and set up promo code if PM approves opt-in model. Need tag names for billing.
Rina (Legal): I'll redline SLA reparations and exclusions. Prefer opt-in for any billing fallback.
Priya (Docs): Docs ETA: can merge quickstart once I get snippets + rollback steps and legal note.
DeployBot: Deploy window scheduled 2026-05-02T07:00:00Z. CI: unit=pass, e2e=pass, perf=queued.
Marcus (Eng): Rollback draft: 1) switch to fallback route, 2) drain pool, 3) scale reserve, 4) run smoke. Snippet: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -d '{"model":"rwd-v1","input":"Hi"}'`
Owen (Finance): Billing tags: billing.bucket=hosted_standard | hosted_burst. Promo = PROMO-GA-OPTIN (3mo 10%); opt-in only.
Rina (Legal): Redlines incoming within 3h, including a transient <5m exclusion and opt-in consent language for fallback.
Lena (SRE): Smoke run invite sent for 2026-05-02T06:30Z. We'll exercise fallback and paging.
Priya (Docs): I'll merge after Marcus' snippet and Rina's redlines. Target: docs published post-deploy.
Ivy (PM): Owners recap: SLA/legal=Rina, rollback+snippets=Marcus, monitoring=Lena, pricing=Owen, docs=Priya. If no blockers, greenlight tomorrow. Post any last-minute issues here. :white_check_mark:
